independent_diagnosis.summary: Eight exact-base cases reproduce failure and verify proposed repair through DOM-only CSS injection; no source edits. Target, Enter, text and overflow preserved. Three captures inspected.

evidence.head: 0e2a681a46aa76f0c11da19d1af2c508d7522ad5
evidence.scope: Independent read-only reproduction on exactPR170head0e2. Local producer fixture/pinned fixture clock. Proposed repair only injected into DOM; no repository/source/test edits.

finding.existing_CI_failure: Six reading orientation compactness failures at820/768/721px in dark and light.
finding.current_assertion: tools/reading_cases.mjs checkReading requires purpose.height <90px at widths721+ and <180px below721; unchanged in this review.
finding.cause: The new max-width1000px layout places the first paragraph across row1 and the boundary plus44px button in row2. Inherited8px row gap makes42+8+44=94px.
finding.measured: Removing only that row gap produces42+0+44=86px for all six reported cases. Phone390 stays117px and desktop1280 stays44px.
finding.accessibility: All8 cases preserve44px button height, readable identical text, no horizontal overflow, and Enter opens the chooser. No target/font/assertion reduction.
